baseline.list_aware_postprocessing: round frozen HGBR to whole dollar; blend 0.75 challenger with 0.25 rounded HGBR in dollar space; round result

screening.oof_seed_role: 2022-02 supplies only past out-of-fold predictions for calibration and blend fitting; it is not included in model selection scores
screening.ranking: pooled screen MdAPE ascending, pooled screen MAPE ascending, then fixed card_id

information_policy.fold_read_cutoff: For each seed/screen/confirmation fold, source rows are filtered to date_sold before the first day of the following month; training rows remain strictly before that held-out month.
information_policy.calibration_and_blend_fit: Use only saved chronological OOF predictions whose sale dates are strictly earlier than the current fold cutoff.
information_policy.off_market_inputs: Never expose list_price to the off-market learner or its calibrators.
information_policy.actual_sale_price_bands: Post-hoc descriptive diagnostics only; never model features, calibration groups, or selection input.
information_policy.final_months: Do not read 2025-05 or 2025-08 labels until both track confirmation candidates are frozen and pass development gates.
information_policy.hidden_labels: Never read hidden test sale labels.

selection_policy: Shortlist is fixed after screen scoring. Confirmation outcomes cannot change candidate definitions or screen selection. Final outcomes cannot change the selected candidate.
fit_accounting: Every real learner, calibration fit, OOF blend-weight fit, failed attempt, or retry consumes one fit. Cache hits do not. Record all starts before execution.
three_checkpoint_policy: Track independent methods against C0 separately from direct-parent cumulative checkpoints. Attempt C0->C1->C2->C3 only when a fixed method improves both tracks against the direct parent on the screen folds; otherwise retain the parent and stop that path. No final-stage tuning.
